mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility rises for several weeks, commuting inflows increase daytime demand around shops and eateries, lifting RETAIL_REC with a lag of up to four weeks. If workplaces stay depressed, retail traffic remains weak.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -28.0 to -17.9 before easing to -20.4 while RETAIL_REC stayed near -20 to -25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move above its prior four-week mean after a sustained two-week increase in WORKPLACES, or it falls despite rising commuting activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in RESIDENTIAL mobility signals people spending more time out of home, which translates into more discretionary store visits within one to two weeks and raises RETAIL_REC. If RESIDENTIAL does not fall, this consumption-release effect weakens.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 6% week-on-week from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL hovered near 7-9 while RETAIL_REC remained around -20 to -25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within two weeks after RESIDENTIAL drops below 6%, or retail worsens while residential stays elevated.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise together, it indicates broad mobility reopening rather than isolated commuting, and retail footfall increases over the next four weeks. If only one series rises, the retail effect is weaker or absent.
evidence_refs: fact:Both series improved from t-2w to t-1w before softening at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the last four weeks when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES increase together for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold move in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent range captures renewed household trip-making and neighborhood activity, which spills over into nearby retail and recreation within one week. If grocery mobility stays below that threshold, the spillover does not appear.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 11% from baseline after being below 8%
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM jumped to 11.3 at t-1w while RETAIL_REC improved to -20.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within one week of GROCERY_PHARM crossing above 11%, or retail declines despite the threshold break.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in PARKS mobility reflects stronger weekend outing intensity and broader leisure demand, which carries into retail and recreation over a four-week window. If park visits remain depressed, retail stays subdued.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS remained around -31 to -34 across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not higher than its prior four-week mean after PARKS improves for two consecutive weeks, or retail falls while parks rise.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -15 while WORKPLACES stays below -20, the city is still operating under constrained movement and retail demand remains soft over the next two weeks. The mechanism fails once both commuting series recover materially.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -15 and WORKPLACES stays below -20 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both negative across the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below its prior four-week mean during periods when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A two-week rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility above 8 indicates more time spent at home, which suppresses discretionary shopping trips and pushes RETAIL_REC downward over the next four weeks. The effect weakens if home-stay intensity does not persist.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 8 and stays there for two weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 8.9 at t-2w and 7.3 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC stayed negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week mean despite two weeks of RESIDENTIAL above 8, or retail does not weaken after the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rebound in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM indicates broader local excursion activity and errands clustering, which should lift retail-and-recreation spending within two weeks. If parks remain weak while grocery stays flat, the signal does not translate into retail gains.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed positive while PARKS stayed near -33
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within two weeks after PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM rise together, or retail declines despite concurrent gains.
